name: raspdac_mini_lcd
description: The RaspDac Mini's display and its remote control
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Drives the RaspDac Mini's 2.4 inch display (the cover of what plays, the track, the volume, repeat and shuffle, a second page with the stream's format) and its remote control, including the DAC's input and filter. One small native program runs both; nothing is compiled on the player and no remote-control daemon is installed.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.99.0 A build for the bench of what will be version 2: a rewrite of version 1 as one small native program.
